metadata.title: मणिपुर: शांति बहाली का फ़ार्मूला | What is the peace formula for Manipur ? | The Adivasi Question
metadata.description: Since May, Manipur is in boil where Kuki and Meitei communities are in a violent face-off. Kukis who resides in the hills of Manipur are asking for a separate administration. Certain areas in the Northeastern States are covered under Sixth Schedule of the Constitution, which helps the tribal areas of these states for Autonomous councils. However, Manipur is not one of these states. Although, Manipur do have autonomous councils but they are not covered under the Sixth Schedule. Since 1960 Kukis are asking for a separate administration under schedule six but till day they are waiting for their voice to be heard. This video explains these issues.
